_doc: Motedis' hammer nut (Hammermutter) for its I-type 8 mm slot, M6. Its tall collar fills the I-type slot's thick lips. Motedis gives no hold.
name: slot-nut-8-i-motedis-m6-hammer

slot.rule: Motedis' I-type 8 mm slot (slot-8-motedis-i), whose nuts are item's family (its nut_family is slot-8-item)

thread.rule: Thread M6, sold as M4, M5, M6

nut_kind.rule: Put in through the opening; it turns a quarter turn by itself as the screw is tightened

length.rule: Along the slot once turned: 8 on the drawing, from the M5's drawing: taken to be the same body
length.source: Motedis, Hammermutter I Typ Nut 8 M5 (S8IHASNM5), drawing https://www.motedis.com/shop/products_files/Motedis_S8IHASNM5-Drawing.pdf, product page https://www.motedis.com/de/Hammermutter-I-Typ-Nut-8-M5 (the M5's drawing: Motedis draws one size)

width.rule: Across the slot once turned: 16 on the drawing, from the M5's drawing: taken to be the same body
width.source: Motedis, Hammermutter I Typ Nut 8 M5 (S8IHASNM5), drawing https://www.motedis.com/shop/products_files/Motedis_S8IHASNM5-Drawing.pdf, product page https://www.motedis.com/de/Hammermutter-I-Typ-Nut-8-M5 (the M5's drawing: Motedis draws one size)

height.rule: The body under the lips: 4,5 on the drawing, from the M5's drawing: taken to be the same body
height.source: Motedis, Hammermutter I Typ Nut 8 M5 (S8IHASNM5), drawing https://www.motedis.com/shop/products_files/Motedis_S8IHASNM5-Drawing.pdf, product page https://www.motedis.com/de/Hammermutter-I-Typ-Nut-8-M5 (the M5's drawing: Motedis draws one size)

tongue_width.rule: Width of the step that stands in the opening, on the drawing, from the M5's drawing: taken to be the same body
tongue_width.source: Motedis, Hammermutter I Typ Nut 8 M5 (S8IHASNM5), drawing https://www.motedis.com/shop/products_files/Motedis_S8IHASNM5-Drawing.pdf, product page https://www.motedis.com/de/Hammermutter-I-Typ-Nut-8-M5 (the M5's drawing: Motedis draws one size)

tongue_height.rule: Height of that step, on the drawing, from the M5's drawing: taken to be the same body
tongue_height.source: Motedis, Hammermutter I Typ Nut 8 M5 (S8IHASNM5), drawing https://www.motedis.com/shop/products_files/Motedis_S8IHASNM5-Drawing.pdf, product page https://www.motedis.com/de/Hammermutter-I-Typ-Nut-8-M5 (the M5's drawing: Motedis draws one size)

nut_entry.rule: Put in through the opening anywhere along the slot

material.rule: Material as the product page names it

hold.rule: Taken as Rexroth's T-nut in an 8 mm slot (4000 N): a hammer nut has the same turned rhomboid body. An estimate until it is tested (Frames 2.13): the maker gives no figure for this nut
hold.source: Bosch Rexroth, Basic Mechanic Elements MGE 14.0 (3 842 540 392, 2019-07), page 3-4 to 3-9; the proof stress from the kit's m6 thread set (ISO 898-1)
